type: source intake observations for independent adjudication; not independent QA

findings.topic: Real CLI stage gate disabled; receipt does not bind dispatch
findings.detail: main calls run_plan with stage_receipt_required default False and no stage_dir; even opt-in only checks stageStatus string. No receipt hash/path/run binding or nested-link verification. Launcher CLI hard-codes original shared harness/Next and cwd, not staged values. Wrapper falls back to command -v python3. Missing binding routes through PROBE_ERROR rather than typed BINDING_ERROR.
findings.effect: Creating an honest private copy/receipt cannot fix or validate the actual execution path. No verified-stage readiness receipt may be issued.

findings.topic: Poll-before-probe still does not prove the full probe interval live
findings.detail: poll_before None followed by lsof and unconditional count increment; exit during probe still counted and no interval sample timestamps are retained. Test35 explicitly passes None then1; sampled absence remains weaker than never-listen. Dead-from-start test34 improves but does not close this temporal gap.
findings.effect: No continuous no-listen claim or genuine lifecycle-bound proof follows; independent reviewer must adjudicate exact source plus retained evidence basis.

findings.topic: Launcher record not correlated to the attempt or durable completion
findings.detail: Evaluator only checks optional record dict, BINDING_ERROR, spawnCalled false and constant guard hash; does not require expected outcome/run/variant/PID/PPID/argv/cwd/start/exit/binary/launcher identity. Record has one timestamp, no start+exit interval or Node binary hash; writer catches errors and lacks file/dir fsync. Test35 supplies only four fields and passes.
findings.effect: A stale/foreign minimal record can satisfy claimed provenance checks; actual persisted identity/durability remains incomplete.

findings.topic: Signal identity weakens if start-time lookup fails
findings.detail: get_process_start_time returns None on query error; optional expected_start_time disables equality check. Executable identity remains basename substring matching. Bare ps/lsof use coordinator ambient resolution. Failed wait can be retried by subsequent cleanup sites; no guarded once-only cleanup disposition.
findings.effect: Do not run runner/owned cleanup before strict non-null identity, pinned helpers and no-retry handling are independently accepted.

findings.topic: Guard hash before import improved; exact-byte identity still path based
findings.detail: Static import removed and raw guard hash checked before dynamic import. Subsequent import rereads mutable path and module cache may apply; no private frozen source/realpath identity binding is enforced by the shipped CLI.
findings.effect: Carry source closure only as independently adjudicated; do not claim checked bytes are necessarily imported bytes under mutation.

findings.topic: Owner test/provenance claims exceed retained coverage
findings.detail: Test44 opts in directly, so it does not cover real CLI default stage bypass. Suite cases45/46 use bare node; case46 uses summary substring. FakeClock is visible for case39, not every scenario. Standalone stderr and per-suite start/end receipts are absent. Plan cp wildcard omits dotfiles and preserves external node_modules symlink; concrete escape count142 is a proposal, not measured evidence.
findings.effect: 46/46 and17/17 are retained owner evidence only; not executable readiness, all-findings closure or actual staging proof.
